retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait featuring a central figure in deep shadow with a vibrant cyan backlight creating a sharp rim light effect.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central human silhouette with long wavy hair and sunglasses, almost entirely obscured by shadow. The subject is defined by a strong, cool-toned cyan glow emanating from behind, casting a sharp rim light on the hair and forehead against a textured, dark wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan backlight vs. deep black foreground
Textured wall surface vs. soft hair silhouette
Sharp rim light vs. obscured facial details
Central vertical subject vs. horizontal background glow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright cyan glow behind the head, drawing focus to the silhouette's edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright cyan halo, follow the rim light down the hair, and settle into the dark center of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of deep black in the lower half and corners emphasize the central light source.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the light source and subject; saturation is concentrated in the cyan highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with varying weights for metadata blocks.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular framing for metadata icons

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the dense, bold metadata aesthetic.
Provides a clean, modern look for technical labels.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a person with long wavy hair and sunglasses, centered. Use a strong cyan backlight to create a rim light effect. The face should be almost entirely in shadow. Add heavy film grain and a textured dark wall background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, white, condensed sans-serif metadata block in the bottom right corner, ensuring it is legible against the dark foreground.

verificationChecks: Is the face primarily in shadow?
Is there visible film grain across the image?
Is the text small and positioned in the bottom right?

mustRedesign: Any visible facial features in the deep shadows
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cyan light does not wash out the silhouette's edge.
Verify the grain is uniform and not blotchy.
Check that the sunglasses are visible only by their silhouette/rim.
Confirm the background wall has subtle vertical texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + Cyan Backlight + Heavy Grain + Obscured Face
